facts.fact: The PMFBY helpline is the Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH), 14447, for queries, grievances and reporting crop loss
facts.quote: Raise Queries, tell us about your Grievances & Report loss of Crop. Call us at 14447 Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH)

facts.fact: There is also the PMFBY WhatsApp ChatBot on 7065514447; both numbers are in the pmfby.gov.in header
facts.quote: WhatsApp ChatBot - 7065514447 | Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH) - 14447

facts.fact: Grievances can also be raised on the KRPH portal (pmfby.gov.in/krph)
facts.quote: Krishi Rakshak Portal & Helpline (KRPH) Tell us about your Grievances & Report loss of Crop. Explore Now

summary: KRPH 14447 and WhatsApp ChatBot 7065514447 confirmed on the pmfby.gov.in header; KRPH portal at pmfby.gov.in/krph.
